pull.title: fix(tui): preserve wheel scrolling with click-to-focus enabled
pull.body:
## What

Restore mouse-wheel scrolling while `tui.mouse` click-to-focus remains enabled. Route captured wheel-up into the existing transcript scroll view by rows, keeping the composer pinned below. Wheel-down to the live tail restores the normal screen and click-to-focus; typing returns to the preserved draft without submitting it. Ctrl+Up/Down retain prompt-hop behavior.

Reuse the existing Composer/TranscriptScrollView rather than adding a separate scrollback implementation. Update the setting description and mouse/navigation documentation.

## Why

With click-to-focus enabled, Herdr forwards wheel events to omp, but the main-session mouse handler consumed them without scrolling. Disabling click-to-focus was only a workaround, not a fix. This preserves both scrolling and click-to-focus.

## Testing

- A real InputController + Composer regression failed before the handler fix: the expected older viewport row did not move. It now proves row-wise wheel movement, access to retained history, draft preservation, return to the live tail, click-to-focus after scrolling, and typing out of scroll mode.
- Focused input/click/keybinding/input-event/transcript-scroll/ScrollView suites: 101 tests passed, 375 assertions.
- Full local `bun run check:ts` passed: lint, formatting, and all workspace no-emit type checks.
- Actual source InputController, Composer, and ProcessTerminal exercised in a real tmux PTY with mouse capture enabled. Wheel input reached the oldest retained prompt; the draft stayed pinned and unchanged. Wheel-down restored the normal screen with capture still enabled, and a subsequent click changed the visible click-to-focus count from 0 to 1. Typing after wheel-up returned to the live screen and appended to the existing draft.
- Full exact-head Woodpecker PR gate #126 passed for `902e3b4aa6d8be78011fc235aaf7216790f8678d`: lint, formatting, all TypeScript checks, Rust checks, web build, native-addon build, and CLI binary build. Merged via PR #14 to `208fbaac02c92148f24ff27ef89c0f4438fa199d`. Fork CI test execution remains disabled by existing policy; this change does not alter that policy.
- No local native or shipping build. No changelog change: not requested.
- Merged-source Woodpecker gate #129 passed for `208fbaac02c92148f24ff27ef89c0f4438fa199d`. Arch pipeline #218 passed using dispatch `cd65506e9d1a2fd67268d4990b873c72c495b6fc`, source `208fbaac02c92148f24ff27ef89c0f4438fa199d`, and validated recipe `8a6eb2b8b4d1b82d34ac94b26c36e5d46cff8cd2`.
- Published package `oh-my-pi-vith-git-18.4.8.vith.r337.g208fbaac02c9-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` and repository database both verified with fully trusted signing fingerprint `433D492D0438666BBB7230BB91D0A55E51016A94`. Repository filename/version/size matched the download, and SHA-256 matched `ad345c4ce82c1c5f8919b9d8accc4f6bb81dd9b9592ac263e36411c81f398be0`.
- Installed the exact signed package with pacman; the transaction upgraded only `oh-my-pi-vith-git` from r335 to `18.4.8.vith.r337.g208fbaac02c9-1`. `command -v omp` reports `/usr/bin/omp`; `omp --version` reports `omp/18.4.8+vith-fork.337.208fbaac02c9`; pacman confirms ownership and the same package version. The existing running session was not restarted.
